body:
@Haroenv that would help people using the `Hits` UI component, for sure !

On our side we have our own UI component but we could do the same as you propose, pass the `sendEvent` to children components.
The only concern is that we have a deep JSX tree before reaching the button that should trigger a `Conversion` event.
Maybe a good workaround in this case is to put this sendEvent method in a homemade context.

I am wondering if it could be interesting to provide this "Insights context" directly from `react-instantsearch-hook-web` package ?
